notes.message: White text on #FF1493 is only 3.64:1, so text on this colour is #171717 (4.93:1).
A separate primary text shade (#D9007B) is used for links and outline buttons so they stay at 4.96:1 on the surface.
Brand accent (#00E5FF) is 1.54:1 against the page, below the 3:1 needed to see a control's edge. The brand fill is kept and controls get a #09A3B5 border (3.04:1).
White text on #00E5FF is only 1.54:1, so text on this colour is #171717 (11.65:1).
A separate accent text shade (#077C84) is used for links and outline buttons so they stay at 4.97:1 on the surface.
Dark-mode primary derived at lightness 72% so the fill keeps 3:1 against the dark surface.
Dark-mode accent derived at lightness 82% so the fill keeps 3:1 against the dark surface.
